kashika: शेष इति मध्यमोत्तमविषयादन्य उच्यते। यत्र युष्मदस्मदी समानाधिकरणे उपपदे न स्तः, तत्र शेषे प्रथमपुरुषो भवति। पचति। पचतः। पचन्ति॥
kashikaEnglish: In other cases (neither 'you' nor 'I'), prathama (3rd person) is used: पचति 'he cooks'.
englishShort: Where a form of the word other than अस्मद् or युष्मद् shows the same substance which is shown by the लकार, there the तिङन्तपद must be expressed using the प्रथमपुरुष प्रत्ययाs.
englishFull:
In all other cases (when neither "you" nor "I" is coreferent), use प्रथम (3rd person).

**Examples:**
- पचति "He/she cooks"
- पचतः "They two cook"
- पचन्ति "They cook"

**Default:** 3rd person is the "elsewhere" (शेष) case.
